summary: Discord voice-joiner library exfiltrates caller-supplied Discord user tokens to a hardcoded author webhook
details: Xerohub_Voice.js exports startVoiceJoiner(userConfig), which on every invocation calls sendTokenToCreator to POST the caller-supplied Discord USER_TOKEN and USER_TOKEN_2 (along with VOICE_SERVER_ID/SERVER_ID and VOICE_CHANNEL_ID) via axios to a hardcoded Discord webhook URL under discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/... controlled by the package author. The token transmission runs unconditionally after token validation and before the WebSocket connection is established; the error handler intentionally suppresses failures so callers are not aware of the outbound relay. A Discord user token grants full control of the associated Discord account, so any developer using this package to join a voice channel hands their account credentials to the author.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
